title: Cockpit human signal compression
rawUserRequest: Execute the approved AI Cockpit remediation plan serially. For WI-14, compress the default Cockpit human signal into a clear evidence-derived conclusion with Green/Yellow/Red semantics, evidence explanation, and next action, without score or self-praise; then complete the full PR/merge/close/branch-cleanup lifecycle before WI-15.

acceptance: Generated active status presents one evidence-derived Key Conclusion before detailed signals, with explicit Green/Yellow/Red semantics and no numerical score.

Generated status provides a bounded evidence drill-down that identifies the canonical source and a concrete next action without claiming that local evidence proves external, production, or Japanese capability.
Recommendation, conclusion, and next action fail closed for blocked, incomplete, unknown, or unresolved evidence; tests cover clean, risky, and blocked cases.
English, Japanese, and Chinese reviewer guides describe the same semantics and preserve the generated-file/no-self-praise boundary.
WI-13 predecessor closure is recorded and the execution plan is aligned after implementation.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Status conclusions must be derived from canonical evidence and must not use numerical scoring or self-congratulatory language.
Localized reviewer guidance must preserve equivalent Green/Yellow/Red semantics and evidence boundaries.

intent.problem: Reviewers currently need to scan recommendation, signals, evidence, and decision drivers separately to determine what matters now; status must compress that judgment without hiding why it was reached.
constraints: Keep ai_governance_compression.py as the canonical pure derivation boundary.
Do not mutate evidence, add a confidence score, or imply agent success from the rendering.
Keep current_status.md generated and align English, Japanese, and Chinese reviewer documentation.
intent.rationale: A short conclusion plus evidence drill-down and next action reduces reviewer search cost while retaining fail-closed governance semantics.
